title: Plugin manifest
description: manifest.json of the built plugin folder: what a host reads before it loads anything. Names of text are keys into words.json, never the text. Every path is relative to the folder.

id.description: Lowercase letters and hyphens: the folder name, and the plugin's id in a chip and a change event.

view.description: The view: an ES module that exports `mount(root, host)`, and its one stylesheet.

engine.description: The engine part: an ES module for Node that exports `createEngine({ dir })`.

chips.description: The kinds of chip the view adds to the chat, each with its label.

tools.description: The tools a bot gets, exactly the engine's `tools.list()`: its name, the key of its description, its input as JSON Schema and whether it writes.

skill.description: The file the bot reads while the plugin is on.

words.description: The words file: every key above and the view's own text, as a flat JSON object.
